_doc: Skills export settings (spec 0110). name_overrides: agent path -> skill name (names over 64 characters, or renames that must keep a published name). exclude: agent paths not exported anywhere. project: which exported skills are materialized in .claude/skills/ for sessions in this repository -- by category (top-level agents/ folder, 'root' for agents directly under agents/) and/or by agent path; omit the section to materialize all. Every exported skill is registered and included in plugin/zip packages regardless. Gitignored (local-only) agent folders are never exported. Rebuild with `quantsmith-skills build` after editing. See instructions/skills_export.md.
